description: Write consistent fiction and adapt existing novels into vertical webtoons with storyboards, lettering, and approvals through a local MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Write fiction and adapt novels into webtoons
interface.longDescription: Plan and write consistent fiction, then adapt existing novels into vertical webtoons through visual-direction interviews, editorial selection, user-approved rough storyboards, image requests, lettering, and separately approved SVG/HTML masters. Image generation requires a capable host.
